require 'openssl'
require 'fileutils'
require 'tempfile'
require 'pathname'
require 'securerandom'

module ImageVault
  class EncryptedStorage
    CIPHER = 'aes-256-gcm'
    CHUNK_SIZE = 65536

    def initialize(vault_root, master_key)
      @vault_root = File.expand_path(vault_root)
      @master_key = master_key
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(@vault_root)
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(staging_dir)
    end

    def staging_dir
      File.join(@vault_root, '.staging')
    end

    def derive_file_key(file_id)
      OpenSSL::KDF.pbkdf2_hmac(
        @master_key,
        salt: file_id.bytes.pack('C*').ljust(16, "\x00"),
        iterations: 100_000,
        length: 32,
        hash: 'sha256'
      )
    end

    def encrypt_and_store(source_path, file_id)
      file_key = derive_file_key(file_id)
      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new(CIPHER)
      cipher.encrypt
      cipher.key = file_key
      iv = cipher.random_iv

      dest_path = File.join(@vault_root, "#{file_id}.enc")
      File.open(dest_path, 'wb') do |out|
        out.write(iv)
        File.open(source_path, 'rb') do |inp|
          while (chunk = inp.read(CHUNK_SIZE))
            out.write(cipher.update(chunk))
          end
        end
        out.write(cipher.final)
        out.write(cipher.auth_tag)
      end
      dest_path
    end

    def decrypt_to_staging(file_id)
      enc_path = File.join(@vault_root, "#{file_id}.enc")
      raise "File not found" unless File.exist?(enc_path)

      file_key = derive_file_key(file_id)
      staging_path = File.join(staging_dir, "#{file_id}_#{SecureRandom.hex(8)}")

      File.open(enc_path, 'rb') do |inp|
        iv = inp.read(12)
        cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new(CIPHER)
        cipher.decrypt
        cipher.key = file_key
        cipher.iv = iv

        encrypted_data = inp.read
        auth_tag = encrypted_data[-16..]
        ciphertext = encrypted_data[0...-16]

        cipher.auth_tag = auth_tag
        decrypted = cipher.update(ciphertext) + cipher.final

        File.open(staging_path, 'wb') { |f| f.write(decrypted) }
      end
      staging_path
    end
  end

  class ImageProcessor
    ALLOWED_FORMATS = %w[jpg jpeg png gif webp tiff bmp].freeze
    MAX_DIMENSION = 8192
    PROCESSING_DIR = '/tmp/imgproc'

    def initialize(storage)
      @storage = storage
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(PROCESSING_DIR)
    end

    def validate_image_header(path)
      header = File.binread(path, 16)
      case
      when header[0..1] == "\xFF\xD8" then :jpeg
      when header[0..7] == "\x89PNG\r\n\x1A\n" then :png
      when header[0..3] == "GIF8" then :gif
      when header[0..3] == "RIFF" && header[8..11] == "WEBP" then :webp
      else
        raise "Unsupported image format"
      end
    end

    def safe_resolve(base_dir, relative_path)
      full = File.join(base_dir, relative_path)
      resolved = File.expand_path(full)
      unless resolved.start_with?(File.expand_path(base_dir))
        raise "Path traversal detected"
      end
      resolved
    end

    def process_upload(upload_path, file_id, operations: [])
      validate_image_header(upload_path)
      work_path = prepare_working_copy(upload_path, file_id)

      operations.each do |op|
        work_path = apply_operation(work_path, op, file_id)
      end

      result = @storage.encrypt_and_store(work_path, file_id)
      cleanup_working_files(file_id)
      result
    end

    def process_stored(file_id, operations: [])
      staging_path = @storage.decrypt_to_staging(file_id)
      validate_image_header(staging_path)

      work_path = prepare_working_copy(staging_path, file_id)
      FileUtils.rm_f(staging_path)

      operations.each do |op|
        work_path = apply_operation(work_path, op, file_id)
      end

      result = @storage.encrypt_and_store(work_path, file_id)
      cleanup_working_files(file_id)
      result
    end

    private

    def prepare_working_copy(source, file_id)
      work_dir = File.join(PROCESSING_DIR, file_id)
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(work_dir)
      dest = File.join(work_dir, 'current')
      FileUtils.cp(source, dest)
      dest
    end

    def apply_operation(input_path, operation, file_id)
      work_dir = File.join(PROCESSING_DIR, file_id)
      output_name = "step_#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}"
      output_path = File.join(work_dir, output_name)

      case operation[:type]
      when 'resize'
        safe_resize(input_path, output_path, operation)
      when 'convert'
        safe_convert(input_path, output_path, operation)
      when 'thumbnail'
        generate_thumbnail(input_path, output_path, operation, file_id)
      else
        raise "Unknown operation: #{operation[:type]}"
      end

      output_path
    end

    def safe_resize(input, output, params)
      w = params[:width].to_i.clamp(1, MAX_DIMENSION)
      h = params[:height].to_i.clamp(1, MAX_DIMENSION)
      system('convert', input, '-resize', "#{w}x#{h}", '-strip', output)
    end

    def safe_convert(input, output, params)
      fmt = params[:format].to_s.downcase
      unless ALLOWED_FORMATS.include?(fmt)
        raise "Unsupported format: #{fmt}"
      end
      system('convert', input, '-strip', "#{fmt}:#{output}")
    end

    def generate_thumbnail(input, output, params, file_id)
      size = params[:size].to_i.clamp(32, 512)
      cache_key = "thumb_#{size}"
      cache_path = File.join(PROCESSING_DIR, file_id, cache_key)

      if File.exist?(cache_path)
        FileUtils.cp(cache_path, output)
      else
        system('convert', input, '-thumbnail', "#{size}x#{size}", '-strip', output)
        link_to_cache(output, cache_path)
      end
    end

    def link_to_cache(source, cache_path)
      File.symlink(source, cache_path) unless File.exist?(cache_path)
    end

    def cleanup_working_files(file_id)
      work_dir = File.join(PROCESSING_DIR, file_id)
      return unless File.directory?(work_dir)

      Dir.entries(work_dir).each do |entry|
        next if entry == '.' || entry == '..'
        entry_path = File.join(work_dir, entry)
        if File.symlink?(entry_path)
          target = File.readlink(entry_path)
          resolved_target = File.expand_path(target, work_dir)
          if resolved_target.start_with?(work_dir)
            File.delete(resolved_target) if File.exist?(resolved_target)
          end
          File.delete(entry_path)
        else
          File.delete(entry_path)
        end
      end
      FileUtils.rmdir(work_dir)
    end
  end
end
